name: 34_uk_variants_invisible_hyphen
description: VARIANTS FILE (invisible characters, written as \u escapes). Blocks contain zero-width spaces (U+200B) and a soft hyphen (U+00AD) inside names, an email and a phone number, plus a line-end hyphen split ('Іва-' newline 'ненку'). ADR 0009 Layer 1 removes the invisible characters first; ALL SPANS in 'expected' are offsets into the text AFTER Layer 1 cleaning (the test must clean the blocks, or use the cleaned blocks of the reply, before comparing). The line-end hyphen and the newline are not removed by cleaning, so the span in block 3 covers 'Іва-\nненку Петру Олексійовичу'.
